_readme: SHARED cloud-ingestion coverage oracle. Byte-identical twin at android/app/src/test/resources/cloud_ingestion_registry.json. CloudIngestionRegistryTests.swift and CloudIngestionRegistryTest.kt assert every live WhoopStore table is declared here as shipped or local_only. Shipped rows name the wire stream, delivery mode, B2 archive stream, and Supabase projection table for the FRWHOOP fork.

serverPhysiologyCacheV2.why: Owner-scoped server physiology readback cache; never uploaded as source physiology. Android uses private preferences.

standardHRReceipt.why: Original standard BLE notification identity and raw bytes; host receipt clocks remain unmapped. Monotonic nanoseconds export as decimal strings to preserve exact integers.

rrPacketProvenance.why: Versioned CRC-checked WHOOP5 v18 sensor packet bytes and immutable word identity; no inferred subsecond clock.

serverScoreCache.why: Authenticated server readback cache; never uploaded as source physiology. Android stores the equivalent cache in preferences.

appleDaily.why: Apple Health daily aggregates imported on-device; upserted verbatim for longitudinal Apple Watch cross-checks.

appleStepHour.why: Hourly Apple Health step buckets; append stream for step-validation against strap counters.

backfillFrontier.why: Backfill duplicate-replay skip frontier (GRDB v45). Operational ingest state — never shipped; Android may adopt separately.

coachMessage.why: On-device AI Coach transcript rows; durable for rare-disease care-team review without recomputation.

cursors.why: Legacy key-value upload/read bookmarks (`highwater:*`, `read:*`). Cloud ingest uses uploadOutbox per-stream cursors and server WAL offsets instead.

dailyMetric.why: Authoritative NOOP-computed daily scores and vitals; server upserts archived rows without re-running StrandAnalytics.

dayOwnership.why: Per-calendar-day device resolver lock for multi-strap UI. Cloud rows carry source_device_id on each upsert; this table is display routing only.

device.why: Legacy single-strap identity row superseded by pairedDevice. FRWHOOP `devices` is provisioned from authenticated push metadata, not this table.

dismissedSleep.why: Android UserDefaults-equivalent sleep tombstone for UI undo. iOS stores the same state in UserDefaults, not SQLite.

dismissedWorkout.why: Android workout dismiss tombstone for UI undo. No cloud replay value; authoritative workouts live in `workout`.

event.why: Decoded strap events (firmware, alarms, diagnostics) from offload.

gravitySample.why: 1 Hz gravity vector and strap dynamic acceleration.

hrSample.why: Measured strap heart rate (bpm) — primary intraday physiology stream.

journal.why: Daily journal question/answer rows (not FRWHOOP flat `events`); highest-value subjective signal for rare-disease cohort.

labMarker.why: Lab Book blood-panel and marker readings entered by the patient; new Supabase home required.

liveSession.why: Silent-guardian coaching session summaries (band time, cue counts); distinct from FRWHOOP manual workout UI state.

metricSeries.why: Long-format (day, key) metric explorer cache projected from analytics and Lab Book.

ouraRaw.why: Verbatim Oura API page archive from opt-in cloud import; replayed as-is for audit.

pairedDevice.why: On-device multi-device registry (brand, capabilities, peripheral mapping). Cloud `devices` row is minted from authenticated ingest metadata.

ppgHrSample.why: PPG-derived HR estimate kept separate from measured `hrSample` for instrumentation review.

ppgWaveformSample.why: Packed 24 Hz PPG waveform BLOBs; gzip/zstd object upload with sidecar manifest, not NDJSON.

rawBatch.why: Pre-decode WHOOP frame batches. Durable in uploadOutbox until ack, then pruned locally; archive is the B2 object keyed like FRWHOOP `pb.zst` frames.

rawImuSession.why: 100 Hz six-axis IMU from ImuSessionFileStore; zstd object lane with manifest sidecar.

rrInterval.why: R-R intervals for HRV; append by SQLite rowid so backfilled timestamps cannot strand rows.

scoreInputProvenance.why: Which source device supplied each computed metric key on each day; required for multi-strap audit.

skinTempSample.why: Skin temperature raw ADC and aux channels.

sleepSession.why: NOOP sleep sessions upserted into `sessions` with kind=sleep; hypnogram JSON preserved verbatim.

sleepStateSample.why: Per-second strap band sleep-state (@81) for staging audit; new Supabase home required.

stepSample.why: WHOOP 5 step counter and activity class.

syncJob.why: Durable post-offload job debt (#1538). Ephemeral scheduling state — not user data and not cloud-shipped.

syncJournalEntry.why: On-device sync pipeline journal for post-offload stages. Operational telemetry — not cloud-shipped.

v18AuxSample.why: Packed unpinned v18 auxiliary field BLOBs; binary object with manifest sidecar.

workout.why: Workout sessions upserted into `sessions` with kind=workout; zones and route preserved in summary JSON.
